title: Application Shortlisting and Screening Timeline
content: All submitted job applications on the Naukri platform undergo initial screening within 3 to 5 business days by the assigned talent acquisition team. Candidates whose profiles match minimum educational qualifications and experience benchmarks will be transitioned to the Screening status. Applications that remain unreviewed after 14 business days are automatically escalated to the recruitment lead for expedited triage.

title: Candidate Resume and Credential Verification
content: Candidates must furnish verified educational certificates, employment history records, and government identity proof prior to final round scheduling. Any discrepancy exceeding 10% in declared prior tenure or unverified academic degrees results in immediate application disqualification. Naukri verified badge holders receive accelerated background credential clearance during initial screening.

title: Interview Scheduling, Rescheduling, and Cancellation
content: Candidates may request a reschedule for technical or managerial interviews up to 24 hours prior to the scheduled slot via the Naukri candidate portal. A maximum of two reschedule requests are permitted per application lifecycle before the interview slot is permanently forfeit. Cancellations made with less than 4 hours notice without an approved emergency reason will result in automatic application rejection.

title: Technical Evaluation and Assessment Standards
content: Technical assessments consist of hands-on coding challenges and domain-specific architectural discussions scored on a standardized 1 to 5 rubric. A composite benchmark score of at least 3.5 is strictly required to qualify for managerial and cultural fit evaluation. Assessment proctoring violations or detected AI-generated code during real-time evaluations trigger an immediate integrity review and test invalidation.

title: Salary Negotiation and Compensation Bands
content: Job offers strictly conform to predefined annual compensation bands determined by job role category, seniority tier, and market percentiles. Salary negotiation is permitted within a 15% range above the initial offer figure upon submission of competitive written offers or exceptional technical assessment ratings. Annual base salaries will not exceed the maximum threshold of INR 3,000,000 without executive compensation board approval.

title: Offer Letter Issuance and Acceptance Window
content: Formal offer letters are released digitally through the Naukri enterprise system within 48 hours following final interview round approval. Candidates are granted a standard validity window of 5 business days to review, digitally sign, and accept the offer terms. If an offer is neither accepted nor an extension formally requested within this period, the offer is revoked and presented to the next shortlisted candidate.

title: Background Verification (BGV) and Criminal Checks
content: All offer extensions are contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive third-party background verification check covering past 7 years of employment. The BGV process audits criminal records, credit solvency for finance roles, and authenticates past employer relieving letters. Adverse findings categorized as red flags by the verification agency will result in immediate offer rescission.

title: Notice Period Buyout and Joining Date Guidelines
content: Standard candidate onboarding is scheduled within 30 to 60 calendar days from offer acceptance depending on candidate notice period obligations. Notice period buyout assistance of up to 30 days basic salary may be approved for critical roles upon business unit head authorization. Requests to defer joining dates beyond 60 days must be submitted at least two weeks before the original joining date.

title: Priority Application Review and Escalation Criteria
content: Applications designated under priority review receive fast-track screening within 24 to 48 hours from submission. Criteria for priority flagging include executive candidate referrals, critical skill shortages in product or engineering, or applications pending past 30 days without status updates. Priority status guarantees a dedicated recruiter contact and daily application status tracking.

title: Candidate Rejection and Cooling-Off Period
content: Candidates who receive a formal rejection after the interview or screening stage are subject to a mandatory 6-month cooling-off period before reapplying for the same role. Reapplications submitted before the cooling-off period expires are automatically filtered out by the portal applicant tracking system. Candidates are free to apply for distinct functional categories during the cooling-off period if skills match.

title: Grievance Redressal and Anti-Fraud Reporting
content: Naukri.com maintains a zero-tolerance policy against fraudulent recruitment activities, payment demands for interviews, and discriminatory hiring practices. Candidates can file formal grievances or report suspicious recruiter activity through the 24/7 Naukri Trust and Safety grievance portal. Verified recruitment fraud results in immediate de-listing of the hiring partner and blacklisting across all affiliate platforms.

title: Candidate Data Privacy and PII Protection
content: Personal identifiable information including phone numbers, government identification numbers, and residential addresses are encrypted at rest and in transit. Recruiter access to unmasked candidate contact details is strictly restricted until mutual interview consent is confirmed. Candidates retain the legal right under data protection regulations to request complete deletion of their application profile and uploaded documents.
